diagnostic_decision.next_work: product: T-LESS Primesense, viewer, and measured domain-gap docs
diagnostic_decision.primary_slice: same 20 frozen objects at N=8 with exact GT cameras

protocol.center_bounds: per-view GT camera-z slab plus 10% slab margin, expanded to include identity
protocol.joint_fit_objective: bidirectional squared sampled Chamfer x1000 from the equal-per-view ray-sample union to 8192 GT surface points

optimizer.deterministic_tie_rule: strict objective decrease; earlier value retained

protocol.population: 49 frozen N={4,8,16} DA3-LARGE GT-pose records; primary gate is the same 20-object N=8 slice

fusion.mask_source: frozen DA3-LARGE border-color masks; no GT masks

fit.fit_scope: joint union with independent scale/shift per source view
